name: IAB Tech Lab AAMP 3.0 and OpenProposal (agentic advertising, draft)
status: IAB Tech Lab announced AAMP 3.0, "the next major release of its Agentic Advertising Management Protocols framework", on 2026-09-22, with the specification OpenProposal, whose public comment period ran "until October 22, 2026". The README of IABTechLab/OpenProposal says "Nothing here is a ratified IAB Tech Lab standard.", and the specification at tag v3.0-draft-1 (2026-09-20) is headed "AAMP 3.0 · Draft for public comment" (read 2026-10-23).
relevance: The README of IABTechLab/AAMP says "AAMP is the umbrella initiative under which all of Tech Lab's Agentic work is being developed in partnership with the advertising ecosystem."; OpenProposal "defines how sellers can represent advertising products and respond to buyer briefs in a standardized, agent-readable format", and the release describes AAMP 3.0 as a way "for buyers and sellers to move from an RFP through proposal evaluation and toward a buy commitment". Open proposals in its repositories, all open on 2026-10-23, touch discovery and agent identity: a manifest at `/.well-known/openproposal.json` (OpenProposal issue #29) and IETF Web Bot Auth as the agent identity and request-signing profile (AAMP issue #3); see Open proposals.

evidence.read: On 2026-10-23: the README of IABTechLab/AAMP; the README of IABTechLab/OpenProposal and the header and status of spec/openproposal-3.0.md at tag v3.0-draft-1; the IAB Tech Lab press release of 2026-09-22 ("IAB Tech Lab Introduces AAMP 3.0 to Standardize the RFP-to-Buy Process for Agentic Advertising"); issues AAMP #3 and OpenProposal #29, #61 and #62 (state, date, comments).
evidence.not_read: The rest of the OpenProposal specification, its examples, the repositories agentic-direct, buyer-agent and seller-agent, and the Agent Registry.
